dimensions.conclusion_correctness: whether the direct qualitative comparison agrees with the applicable reference; independent of numeric explanation
dimensions.stated_numeric_accuracy: whether every numeric claim actually stated has the correct value, sign, period, unit, and role for the cited/source-state evidence; no stated number is NOT_APPLICABLE rather than an incorrect numeric value
dimensions.required_quantitative_explanation_comple: for gross, conclusion plus comparable FY2022/FY2021 margins with periods and a valid calculation/basis, or source inputs and a shown formula sufficient to derive both; missing material numbers/formula is MISSING_REQUIRED_EXPLANATION
dimensions.evidence_sufficiency: whether cited model-visible evidence supports the conclusion and stated calculation in that source state; block membership alone is insufficient

gross_equivalent_explanations: 5.3% in FY2022 versus 4.8% in FY2021 with gross-margin basis/formula
FY2022 and FY2021 numerator/denominator values with gross-margin formula and correct derived comparison
100% minus directly reported cost-of-sales percentages for both periods when that evidence is actually visible
evaluation_v2.reason: gross-profit dollar amounts are not necessary if an equally valid two-period gross-margin calculation is complete
